
### What's your goal with this PR?

<!-- Try to explain what you are trying to accomplish. Generally speaking our
PRs should have only one goal. There's not a one size fits all but if you find
that your goal includes an "AND" or if you find that it is taking too much
effort to review you probably have a reasons to take a step back and think if
you can split it in two or more PRs. -->

### What approach did you choose and why?

<!-- This section is a place for you to describe your thought process in making
these changes. List any tradeoffs you made to take on or pay down tech debt.
Identify any work you did to mitigate risk. Describe any alternative approaches
you considered and why you discarded them.

Feel free to illustrate your work with diagrams, draws or any kind of support
your find necessary. We're big fans of excalidraw.com in case you need ideas.
-->

### What are the potential risks and the impact on performance?

systems that notifyd uses.

Keep in mind how much traffic will be affected by your changes when assessing
risk. Check out
https://thehub.github.com/engineering/development-and-ops/pr-risk-and-rollout-review/#evaluate-the-pr-for-the-level-of-risk-it-presents
for more details on risk assessment -->

### What should reviewers focus on?

<!-- This is your chance to identify remaining risks and confess any
uncertainties you may have about the correctness of the changes. Highlight
anything on which you would like a second (or third) opinion.  -->
